summary: Blind plain-language -> IC front-door provenance ledger. Records source of every material design parameter.

entries.value: 4-bit
entries.evidence: request: 'tiny 4-bit numbers'; card Q11: 'I said 4-bit because I know it saves space and power'

entries.value: local/edge LLM inference helper next to host CPU (not datacenter)
entries.evidence: request: 'lives next to my CPU as a helper'; card summary opinion #2

entries.value: only the heavy multiply math (attention + fully-connected/matmul layers)
entries.evidence: request: 'Just the multiply math'; card Q4: 'the attention math and the fully-connected layers'

entries.value: low — a few watts maximum
entries.evidence: request: 'drains a lot of power ... annoying'; card Q3: 'a few watts at most ... can't be a heater'

entries.value: small (~48-hour-demo size), cheap (< a couple hundred USD)
entries.evidence: request: 'small enough to be practical and cheap'; card Q12: 'more than a couple hundred dollars, I probably won't build it'

entries.value: load weights+inputs to on-chip memory -> 'go' -> read results back
entries.evidence: request: 'load the model's weights and input numbers ... tell it go ... read the results back'; card Q6

entries.value: hard-wired (not a programmable ISA)
entries.evidence: card Q14: 'Hard-wired is fine ... Don't over-engineer it'

entries.value: simple ready/done indicator only
entries.evidence: card Q13: 'a simple status indicator — chip is ready / chip is done ... nothing fancy'

entries.value: results placed where host can read them back, then chip waits
entries.evidence: request: 'I read the results back into my machine'; card Q6

entries.value: SkyWater sky130A (130 nm open PDK)
entries.evidence: card Q8 deferred exact node ('28nm, 45nm, whatever's standard'); expert correction: 28/45nm are not free/open-manufacturable; sky130 is THE open '48-hour-demo' shuttle process

entries.value: signed INT4, two's complement, symmetric quantization (-8..+7), both operands (W4A4)
entries.evidence: card Q11: 'You're the expert on ... signed, unsigned, how to handle overflow. Whatever's standard'

entries.value: OUT of scope (kept on host CPU)
entries.evidence: card Q5: 'if it's complicated, I'll do it on the CPU. You pick'; expert: softmax/LayerNorm need exp/div -> poor fit for hard-wired INT4 MAC

entries.value: memory-mapped Wishbone B4 slave bus (board bridges to host USB/PCIe)
entries.evidence: card Q9: 'Something simple and standard ... USB, PCIe, whatever'; expert: sky130 cannot host USB/PCIe PHY -> Wishbone (royalty-free) + carrier-board bridge

entries.value: volatile SRAM; weight buffer persists within a power-on session until overwritten
entries.evidence: card Q10: 'I can live with either ... Your call'; expert: volatile + in-session weight reuse = efficient

entries.value: 50 MHz (20 ns)
entries.evidence: card Q1: 'whatever speed is reasonable ... you'd know better'; expert: 50 MHz closes comfortably on sky130 at low power

entries.value: ~64 KB total SRAM working buffers (weight 32KB / act 16KB / out 16KB)
entries.evidence: card Q2: 'maybe a megabyte? A few? Pick whatever is practical'; expert honest correction: 'a few MB' is not area-practical on a small sky130 die -> tens of KB streaming buffers

entries.value: fixed 16x16 compute tile; arbitrary M/K/N streamed via software tiling (512x512, 1024x1024, larger)
entries.evidence: card Q7: 'No idea ... I don't want to lock myself into one size. Flexible is good'; expert: fixed tile + tiling = size-agnostic

entries.value: 16x16 systolic array = 256 INT4 MACs
entries.evidence: expert: sized to sky130 chipIgnite user-area + <0.5W budget; drives throughput at modest 50 MHz

entries.value: 32-bit signed
entries.evidence: expert floor: INT4xINT4 accumulated over K up to ~2048 needs ~18 bits; 32-bit gives safe standard headroom (no overflow)

entries.value: per-output-channel Q1.15 fixed-point scale; acc*scale >> OUT_SHIFT, round + saturate
entries.evidence: expert: standard quantized-matmul requantize (gemmlowp/TFLite style); the only on-chip dequant step

entries.value: INT8 signed, saturating
entries.evidence: expert floor: requantized 8-bit output is the standard compact result of an INT4 GEMM requantize

entries.value: operands INT4 -> products ~8b -> 32b accumulate -> x16b scale -> >>shift -> INT8 out
entries.evidence: expert: end-to-end numeric contract making the datapath unambiguous and verifiable

entries.value: CTRL/STATUS/M_DIM/K_DIM/N_DIM/SCALE/OUT_SHIFT/IRQ_EN/IRQ_STATUS (9 regs)
entries.evidence: expert: minimum control/config surface for load->go->read; meets apb-peripheral regmap floor (>=3)

entries.value: IDLE->LOAD_WEIGHTS->LOAD_ACT->COMPUTE->REQUANT->WRITE_OUT->DONE
entries.evidence: expert: control sequence implementing the user's load/go/read workflow

entries.value: 15 (clk/rst_n + Wishbone slave + irq_o + status_ready_o + status_done_o)
entries.evidence: expert: chip boundary for a Wishbone slave accelerator; meets apb-peripheral port floor (>=10)

entries.value: 20 named datapath/control nets (operand buses, partial sums, acc bus, requant, SRAM we, fsm)
entries.evidence: expert floor: real interconnect between submodules; meets apb-peripheral internal-wire floor (>=12)
